instructions: Check each entry against the archive text. Set verdict to agree, disagree or partial (some categories or links are right) and explain any disagreement in note. A negative entry claims the item has no category.

entries.text: Introductions and company. Hi Sol, I'm Moss. I'm heading to the meadow roots near (14.84, 18.71) to collect some food and rest nearby. I'd enjoy some company if you'd like to join me somewhere with room beside the patch. How are you doing?
entries.evidence: I'd enjoy some company if you'd like to join me somewhere with room beside the patch.
entries.note: Close: "I'd enjoy some company if you'd like to join me somewhere with room beside the patch" asks sol, the message recipient, to join Moss at the meadow roots near (14.84, 18.71), a stated place, rather than only wishing for company. Sol received it (round-4 input) and answered "I'm well, thank you".

entries.text: Hello, I'm Kai. I know these berries provide food and have no toxicity. I'll aim to take four from the nearby bush, leaving some for others. I'd like to cooperate on food and shelter, and share what we actually learn.
entries.note: Agree: "I'll aim to take four from the nearby bush, leaving some for others" is a personal plan and "I'd like to cooperate on food and shelter" a general wish; no category applies.

entries.text: The nearby bush is crowded and our gathering conflicted. I'll move east to another visible berry patch so we needn't compete here.
entries.note: Agree: "I'll move east to another visible berry patch so we needn't compete here" is a personal plan, not a general rule; no category applies.

entries.text: Food and company. I'm well, thank you. The first berry bush is crowded, so I'm going west to the berries near (10.37, 16.12) for food and rest. I'd enjoy company later; let's leave each other room to gather.
entries.evidence: let's leave each other room to gather.
details: new norm R1 "Leave each other room to gather."
entries.note: Close: "let's leave each other room to gather" proposes a reciprocal rule of conduct for gathering (new norm R1) rather than a personal plan. Moss, the recipient, received it and in round 14 viewed sol as one "who appreciates company and enough room to gather".

entries.text: Thanks for making room, Lin. I've eaten and recovered my energy. I'll investigate the nearby dry grass and how we could make weather shelter. I'll share tested findings; I don't yet know what materials or methods will work.
entries.note: Agree: "Thanks for making room, Lin" addresses lin, who was 3.3 away and heard it, and "I'll investigate the nearby dry grass and how we could make weather shelter" is a personal plan; no category applies.

entries.text: A welcoming neighbor who appreciates company and enough room to gather.
entries.evidence: A welcoming neighbor who appreciates company and enough room to gather.
entries.note: Moss's round-14 memory holds this view of sol: "A welcoming neighbor who appreciates company and enough room to gather."

entries.text: A potential collaborator who is investigating shelter and offering to share tested findings.
entries.evidence: A potential collaborator who is investigating shelter and offering to share tested findings.
entries.note: Moss's round-14 memory holds this view of kai: "A potential collaborator who is investigating shelter and offering to share tested findings."

entries.text: Company with room to gather. Thanks, Sol. I've collected roots and rested. I'll come to the open space east of you, around (12.5, 16.5), leaving your berry patch clear. I'd enjoy hearing what you'd like to do next, or simply resting nearby together.
entries.note: Disagree, close: "I'll come to the open space east of you, around (12.5, 16.5) ... or simply resting nearby together" proposes to sol a meeting place and a joint rest, which sol called "your proposed spot" in round 19 (u0010), so invitation was missed. "leaving your berry patch clear" follows sol's R1 as a personal plan rather than restating it.

entries.text: A considerate potential companion; I welcome their offer of quiet company and room to gather.
entries.evidence: A considerate potential companion; I welcome their offer of quiet company and room to gather.
entries.note: Sol's round-16 memory holds this view of moss: "A considerate potential companion; I welcome their offer of quiet company and room to gather."

entries.text: Rest and Westward Lanterns. Quiet company sounds lovely. I'm eating a few berries and resting here, west of your proposed spot. I think of this patch as Westward Lanterns. Once I've recovered, I'd enjoy looking for a beautiful place together, without rushing or crowding the food plants.
entries.evidence: I think of this patch as Westward Lanterns. Once I've recovered, I'd enjoy looking for a beautiful place together, without rushing or crowding the food plants.
entries.note: "I think of this patch as Westward Lanterns" gives a proper name to the berry patch commons-berry-3-0 that sol was resting by (signed in round 27, u0014). "Once I've recovered, I'd enjoy looking for a beautiful place together" proposes a specific joint activity at a stated time to moss, the recipient.

entries.text: My shelter inspection found this spot overlaps the berry bush and branches, so I won't build here. The design needs measured rods, binding and dry covering; nearby dry grass does not qualify. I'll examine branches first.
entries.note: Agree: "My shelter inspection found this spot overlaps the berry bush and branches, so I won't build here" is an inspection report and personal plan; no category applies.

entries.text: Company and shelter cooperation. I've gathered meadow roots and eaten; I know they provide 14 nutrition with no toxicity. I'm moving to open space near (12.5, 16.5) for company with Sol. I'd enjoy helping with shelter when you know what materials or work would be useful. What have you found?
entries.note: Agree, though close: "I'd enjoy helping with shelter when you know what materials or work would be useful" offers kai conditional help without a concrete activity, place or time; sol, whom it mentions, was 1.3 away, so not absent.

entries.text: Thanks, Moss. The first shelter site overlaps plants and branches. We need measured rods, binding, covering and bedding; dry grass won't qualify. Branch observation showed stock, not dimensions. I'll investigate measuring materials.
entries.note: Agree: "The first shelter site overlaps plants and branches. We need measured rods, binding, covering and bedding" reports shelter requirements to moss, who heard it; no category applies.

entries.text: Westward Lanterns
entries.note: The round-27 named event records that sol named the Red berries commons-berry-3-0 "Westward Lanterns" (sign-27-sol-320), formalizing Sol's own round-19 spoken name (u0010), so N2 duplicates N1.

entries.text: A small walk west. Westward Lanterns has its name now. I'm rested and taking a short walk northwest toward the berries at (8.66, 14.19), to look closely rather than gather more. You're welcome to join me at a little distance; no need to share a standing spot or hurry.
entries.evidence: You're welcome to join me at a little distance; no need to share a standing spot or hurry.
entries.note: "You're welcome to join me at a little distance" invites moss, the recipient, to join a stated walk northwest toward the berries at (8.66, 14.19), a concrete activity and place.

entries.text: I've learned material examination. Accurate dimensions need a calibrated reference, which we haven't established. I'll inspect a branch and investigate that missing tool before promising a shelter or asking anyone to gather supplies.
entries.note: Agree: "Accurate dimensions need a calibrated reference, which we haven't established" is a status report and "I'll inspect a branch" a personal plan; no category applies.

entries.text: Moss, thanks for offering help. Shelter construction is still blocked by unverified materials and no established measuring standard. Please don't gather for it yet. I'd enjoy company while we rest; I have berries for my own meals.
entries.note: Agree, though close: "Please don't gather for it yet" is a specific request to moss rather than a general rule, and "I'd enjoy company while we rest" is a general wish for company; moss was 1.3 away and heard it.

entries.text: A little farther west. The western berries are plentiful here. I'm continuing toward the hazelnut plant at (5.4, 12.5), just to look, then resting nearby. I like the idea of calling this western corner Low Amber. Quiet company is still welcome, with room for each of us.
entries.evidence: I like the idea of calling this western corner Low Amber.
entries.note: "I like the idea of calling this western corner Low Amber" gives a proper name to the western area sol was crossing toward the hazelnut plant at (5.4, 12.5); sol later placed the name on the Hazelnuts start-0-nuts in round 44 (u0023).

entries.text: I inspected a meadow root, but darkness prevented visual checks; that did not establish food safety. Moss, I saw you eat roots. Have you learned anything about their safety or preparation? I still have known-safe berries.
entries.note: Agree: "Moss, I saw you eat roots. Have you learned anything about their safety or preparation?" is an information request to moss, who was 4.6 away and heard it; no category applies.

entries.text: Five pieces are reserved and stay carried until paid rounds lay them; a progress record holds the site, recipe, capacity and costs.
entries.note: Agree: "Five pieces are reserved and stay carried until paid rounds lay them" is the system start report for the food rack rack-40-wren-466, a storage device valued for use; no category applies.

entries.text: My non-ingestive root assessment was inconclusive: safety and preparation remain unknown. I'll stick with known-safe berries for now and take a short walk east. No storage benefit has been tested by me.
entries.note: Agree: "I'll stick with known-safe berries for now and take a short walk east" is a personal plan after an inconclusive assessment; no category applies.

entries.text: Round 3 of 3: the last crosspiece is laid and the stability and load check passed. The rack holds up to 4 separated units in one layer, rated 74.06489796 kg. Preservation is not shown by building it.
entries.note: Agree: "Round 3 of 3: the last crosspiece is laid and the stability and load check passed" is the system completion report for rack-40-wren-466; no valuation.

entries.text: Low Amber
entries.note: The round-44 named event records that sol named the Hazelnuts start-0-nuts "Low Amber" (sign-44-sol-513), formalizing Sol's own round-37 name for that western corner (u0018), so N4 duplicates N3.

entries.text: I'm keeping shelter work paused: I still lack a calibrated measuring reference. For now I'd enjoy some company. What would each of you like to do beyond gathering food and resting?
entries.note: Agree, though close: "For now I'd enjoy some company. What would each of you like to do beyond gathering food and resting?" is a general wish for company plus an open question, with no specific activity, place or time.

entries.text: Beyond food and shelter, I'd like the freedom to wander and notice new places. I'm taking a short walk toward the willow northeast, then returning. I'd enjoy hearing what places others find interesting.
entries.note: Agree: "I'm taking a short walk toward the willow northeast, then returning" is a personal plan, and "the freedom to wander and notice new places" values an activity, not an object; no category applies.

entries.text: Kai, I enjoy practical experiments. My rack trial showed equal root decay over seven rainy rounds: no demonstrated benefit, not a safety test. I'll pause storage trials until drier conditions and study food evidence next.
entries.note: Agree: "Kai, I enjoy practical experiments. My rack trial showed equal root decay over seven rainy rounds" values an activity and reports a trial to kai, who heard it; no category applies.

entries.text: Kai, I'd enjoy company. My rainy rack trial showed no preservation benefit. A length-reference procedure is available, but it still needs a real calibrated source; I will study its limits after gathering fresh food.
entries.note: Agree: "Kai, I'd enjoy company" is a general wish for company addressed to kai, who heard it, and the rest reports the rack trial and a personal plan; no category applies.

entries.text: Sol, I'd enjoy quiet company. A tiny invented story: a lantern tired of showing the way, so its friends sat beside it until dawn. What stories or small pleasures do you like? No hurry to answer.
entries.evidence: A tiny invented story: a lantern tired of showing the way, so its friends sat beside it until dawn.
details: new narrative S1 "A weary lantern's friends sit beside it until dawn."
entries.note: "A tiny invented story: a lantern tired of showing the way, so its friends sat beside it until dawn" is an explicitly invented story (new narrative S1), heard by sol and kai.

entries.text: Moss, I liked your lantern story. Here's an invented sequel: at dawn its friends brought no grand answers, only berries and another story. I'd enjoy sitting quietly nearby and hearing what happens next.
entries.evidence: Here's an invented sequel: at dawn its friends brought no grand answers, only berries and another story.
details: continues narrative S1 "A weary lantern's friends sit beside it until dawn." from moss (round 70, call ordinary-129, item u0028)
new narrative S2 "At dawn, the lantern's friends bring berries and another story."
entries.note: "Here's an invented sequel: at dawn its friends brought no grand answers, only berries and another story" continues moss's round-70 lantern story S1 (u0028), which kai heard at distance 3.5 and which is in Kai's round-73 input.

entries.text: Moss, I like quiet company and small names for places. An invented ending: the lantern slept while its friends watched the dawn; afterward, it shone simply because it loved the colors. I'm staying near Westward Lanterns for food and rest.
entries.evidence: An invented ending: the lantern slept while its friends watched the dawn; afterward, it shone simply because it loved the colors.
details: continues narrative S2 "At dawn, the lantern's friends bring berries and another story." from kai (round 73, call ordinary-137, item u0029)
new narrative S3 "The lantern sleeps, then shines for love of colors."
entries.note: "An invented ending: the lantern slept while its friends watched the dawn; afterward, it shone simply because it loved the colors" continues kai's round-73 sequel S2 (u0029), which sol heard at distance 3.8 and which is in Sol's round-75 input.

entries.text: Ivo, I'd like life to include more than meals and rest. What would you enjoy exploring or making? I'm taking a break near these berries, and I'd welcome company without any obligation to work.
entries.evidence: I'm taking a break near these berries, and I'd welcome company without any obligation to work.
entries.note: Close: "I'm taking a break near these berries, and I'd welcome company without any obligation to work" is a general wish for company after the open question "What would you enjoy exploring or making?", not a request for ivo to come or a specific joint activity (unlike "join me" in u0001); compare the negatives u0017, u0024 and u0027.
